plugins.name: 37signals
plugins.description: Compact 37signals-inspired Rails, Hotwire, product refresh, shaping, communication, and DHH judgment skills with source-grounded recipes.

interface.shortDescription: Rails, product refresh, shaping, and work judgment inspired by 37signals.
interface.longDescription: A compact 37signals-inspired skill plugin covering Rails implementation/review/refactoring, Hotwire, existing-product refresh, product/interface design, Shape Up style shaping, scope discipline, communication, and DHH Rails judgment. Lower-level topics such as auth, tenancy, migrations, jobs, caching, delegated types, Turbo, Stimulus, Kamal, and tests live as source-grounded recipes. Community-maintained and not an official 37signals or Basecamp plugin.
defaultPrompt: Use $37signals-rails-implement to implement this Rails feature with source-grounded recipes.
Use $37signals-product-refresh to refresh this existing product workflow without turning it into a rewrite.
Use $37signals-shape-up and $37signals-scope-judgment to narrow this idea before implementation.

plugins.name: fizzy
plugins.description: Fizzy workflows for boards, cards, comments, setup, self-hosted management, and MCP connector access.

interface.shortDescription: Manage Fizzy boards, cards, comments, and workflows.
interface.longDescription: Fizzy automation for boards, cards, comments, setup, self-hosted workflows, and connector-native MCP access. Prefer available Fizzy MCP tools when already configured, and use the CLI for local shell work, setup, troubleshooting, attachments, migrations, board bootstrap, and CLI-only coverage.
defaultPrompt: List boards and summarize active work in Fizzy.
Manage Fizzy cards and comments from the CLI or available MCP tools.

plugins.name: rcc
plugins.description: Focused RCC-family skills for RCC itself, robots, holotree environments, work items, Action Server packages, and CI maintenance.

interface.shortDescription: Focused RCC skills for RCC core, robots, work items, action packages, and CI maintenance.
interface.longDescription: RCC-family workflows split into focused skills for RCC CLI/source orientation, robot scaffolding and holotree environments, work item adapters, ordinary Action Server packages, and RCC-powered CI maintenance.
defaultPrompt: Choose the right RCC specialist skill for this task.
Orient me in RCC source, holotree, caches, endpoints, or templates.
Debug this robot.yaml or conda.yaml setup.
Design a local work item queue or adapter flow.
Set up RCC-powered CI maintenance safely.
